decision: Retain shadcn as a development-only, lockfile-pinned authoring tool. Removing it would discard the project-configured component CLI; npm suggested shadcn@1.0.0 is not a CLI and is not a valid fix. Do not change the dependency until a compatible upstream fix or a validated replacement exists.
next_gate: Inspect and run the final app/admin Docker images including base image digests; this is still required for K02 and was not attempted here.
limitations: Static repository inspection only; no package install, audit, build, test, image build, or deployment was run.
The component configuration is evidence of intended CLI compatibility, not proof that current contributors invoke the CLI.
